scope: Native Linux development player, Unity Editor closed, 1920x1080, 100% render scale, uncapped (vSync off), PC quality, OpenGL Core, RTX 3060 12 GB / i9-10850K, driver 610.57.04. Checkpoint route = the unchanged 20.25 s warmed check_checkpoint.py traversal (locker start, four headings). Depot routes from unity/tools/check_depot.py: the nest fight (real F input, QA cameraYaw to face the nearest droid) and a warmed 28 s walk over depot_approach/yard/hall. Desktop apps held ~3.2 GB of the 12 GB VRAM during all runs (Hyprland, quickshell, Electron apps, Nautilus, Steam); a Jellyfin thumbnail ffmpeg was running at nice 10.

checkpoint_route.verdict: p99 16.99 / 16.71 ms against 16.67: a narrow FAIL of the p99 target (West Gate measured 16.50 at 00:05 under lower desktop VRAM use). Average FPS passes easily. The p99 frames are the east heading into the city (24M submitted triangles), not the depot.

depot.verdict: PASS: fight p99 8.64 ms, walk p99 16.0 ms, no hitches. An earlier fight sample (native-depot-run2) had one 147 ms frame caused by the QA ScreenCapture PNG encode during profiling; check_depot.py no longer captures while profiling.

vram_finding.symptom: Without mip streaming the player held 8.35 GiB GPU memory (6.5 GB textures) on top of ~3.2 GB desktop use: 11.8 of 12 GB. Facing the city from the checkpoint the driver paged (GPU 100% busy at 70 W, ~100 ms frames: p99 102 ms, 42 frames over 100 ms); the city loop then ran at 7-88 fps and dropped a quick second Escape (the city-loop pause assertion failed twice).
vram_finding.fix: ProjectSettings/QualitySettings.asset, PC level: streamingMipmapsActive 0 -> 1, streamingMipmapsMemoryBudget 512 -> 4096 MB (max level reduction 2, unchanged). Textures resident 6.5 -> 4.2 GB, player GPU memory 8.35 -> 6.71 GiB; the same heading now renders at p50 14.9 / p99 16.0 ms. Near-field sharpness compared against the West Gate locker close-up: no visible loss. Rollback copy: QualitySettings-before-streaming.asset.
vram_finding.also: Depot Poly Haven prop textures (32) capped at 1k on Standalone (crane keeps 2k).
